reason: I'd love to get my evenings back, but 'connects to the tools you already use' with a CRM and Google example doesn't tell me it works with what I actually run, and at 59 to 99 euros a month on my income I can't pay to find out. At most I'd poke at the free plan one night and probably never come back to it.
objection: It won't plug into my specific tools, and I'll end up spending more nights setting it up and checking its work than it saves me. Plus 'credits' means I have no idea what 100 a month actually gets me.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it working on my own setup in the free demo, answering my real customer emails and posting for me, with a clear idea of how many replies and posts 100 credits covers.
